private-cloud-compute.reason: No managed com.apple.developer.private-cloud-compute entitlement on this executable; --allow-cloud never passed; zero requests sent.

limitations: Exploratory shared-desktop run; not an idle-machine production promotion gate.
Apple system model weights are OS-managed and not independently revision-pinnable.
Process-first timing is not guaranteed model-cold; platform services can retain models.
Per-backend timing boundaries are recorded in metadata; input conversion may differ.
Client RSS excludes shared Apple model services and may exclude the Parakeet sidecar; not an apples-to-apples model-memory comparison.
Errors/missing outputs are counted; final-text quality treats them as empty outputs, never silently drops them.
Natural-speech and synthetic technical-term tiers are reported separately.
Whisper candidates were exercised functionally on CPU only after ANE compilation/load failures; no accelerator latency is claimed for them.
Apple system speech and language models are OS-managed; no independent revision pin exists.

Dictation "punctuation on" runs were measured after the unpunctuated runs in the same process-warm session order; latency differences between the two configurations are within run-to-run noise on a shared desktop.
empty_transcripts counts completed rows with no text on a clip that has speech; every measured candidate scored 0 on every tier.
